title: Azure Developer Foundations
description: Understand Azure's core concepts, resource hierarchy, portal, CLI, Cloud Shell, and developer workflows.
longDescription: This module introduces the foundational concepts every Azure developer should know. You will learn how Azure organizes resources, how to navigate the portal and CLI, how regions and availability zones work, and how to set up a productive local development workflow.
whatYouLearn: Explain what Azure is and who it is for
Use the Azure Portal and Cloud Shell effectively
Understand regions, availability zones, and resource groups
Use Azure CLI and developer tooling from the command line
Set up a practical Azure developer workflow
